svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.76k stars in total, about 1.11k a year earlier. mr boxington 525, aube 2037, fnox 2288, hk 1271, pitchfork 688, usage 1057, +6 more 890.
